mark: Its route_local bench: gain beyond the interval, bit-exact
evidence: README 'Exact Commands': its pytest (test_deepseek_v4_1_sp_prefill.py, test_deepseek_v41_tilelang_router.py) on the candidate image, two boots, patched-file mounts dropped because the image carries 0767. The README's bench, python3 /tmp/bench_sp_moe.py, is not in the PR (it lived in sp5's /tmp), so the route_local mark is measured with our harness bench_996_route_local.py: the image's own TileLangGateRouter.route_local, called as one SP rank calls it on the 20 encoder layers of a prefill step (fake forward context with is_padding and input_ids, as the PR's padded_step test fixture does), run unchanged on the candidate image and on 1107, two boots each, output hashes compared across images. Supplementary (ours): the same calls under torch.inference_mode, which is how the vLLM worker runs the model (gpu_model_runner's @torch.inference_mode)

measured.tail_rank_cells: 5 of 5 TP3 tail-rank cells faster beyond the two-boot interval, on per-call and on 20-layer-pass timing
measured.non_tail_ranks: 23 cells without a padded tail: mostly within the interval; 4 per-call cells are 0.2-1.8% slower beyond it (e.g. TP3 T2048 rank0 79.056/80.144 -> 80.641/81.52 us), i.e. the cache lookup costs about 1 us where there is nothing to save
measured.tp4: every TP4 cell (T = 768..16384, all multiples of 4) has real_rows == local_rows, so TP4 has no tail rank on this grid; the PR's TP4 tail-rank gains (e.g. 46.91 -> 26.37 us at T=1024) cannot come from tail-mask caching and are not reproduced (TP4 T1024 rank3: 39.552/37.456 -> 39.633/39.136 us)
measured.bit_exactness: real-row weights (as int32) and expert ids hash identically on 1107 and candidate-49 in all 28 (TP, T, rank) cells, on both boots, at layers 1 and 20 of every step; tail pad rows route to id -1 on both images in these cells (local_rows > 256)

inference_mode.candidate-49_boot1: 5 of 5 cases raise RuntimeError: Inference tensors do not track version counter. (router.py line 203, cache[key] = (mask, mask._version, local)), reached from _routing_masks line 266 (TP3 T1024 rank0 and rank2, TP3 T6144 rank0) and from _partials_mask line 285 (TP3 T205 rank2, TP4 T1024 rank3)
inference_mode.candidate-49_boot2: the same 5 of 5 cases raise the same RuntimeError at the same lines
inference_mode.1107_boot1: 5 of 5 cases return; the 4 that have a no_grad cell (all but TP3 T205) hash as in the no_grad bench
inference_mode.1107_boot2: 5 of 5 cases return, same hashes as boot1

measured.interval: two container boots per image; each cell is the median over 10 measured steps x 19 cached layer calls (per-call, synced) or over 10 measured 20-layer passes; a gain is beyond the interval when the slower candidate boot beats the faster 1107 boot

parts.part: route_local bench: gain beyond the interval
parts.detail: TP3 tail rank 1.015x-1.24x faster beyond the interval at T = 1024..16384, matching the PR's TP3 direction and size (PR -30.54% .. -2.95%); no gain on ranks without a tail, and no TP4 tail exists at these T
real rows identical to 1107 in every cell

parts.part: works as the worker calls it
parts.detail: under torch.inference_mode the patched _local_mask reads mask._version of an inference tensor and raises on every SP route_local call tried, tail rank or not; 1107 runs the same calls

reason: The tail-mask cache gives its small TP3 tail-rank gain and stays bit-exact, but only outside inference mode. Under torch.inference_mode, as the vLLM worker runs the forward, the patched _local_mask raises RuntimeError on every sequence-parallel route_local call (5 of 5 cases, both boots), where 1107 completes them. A serving engine with SP prefill would fail its first prefill, so the PR cannot deliver its metric and would break the zero-failed-requests core metric. Fix to try in the rework: do not read _version of an inference tensor (for example key the cache on the mask's identity within the step only, or check mask.is_inference() first).
notes: commands.txt start_utc is when the command was issued and includes any wait on /tmp/spark-lab-gpu.lock

The inference-mode failure matches a comment on PR #996 (2026-11-09T02:38Z) reporting this traceback at tp3-triangle in candidate-49's stack; our check reproduces it on one GPU independently of topology
